scope: Native base Popup anchoring, ListState/List options and Button close/trigger; real list focus/Enter/Escape/arrows, scoped Space confirm, native deferred context guard and prior-focus restoration. Existing auto/zh/en set_language, config save and toolbar events unchanged.
new_tests: No layout-mirroring tests added; existing regression suite plus actual keyboard/mouse/UI tests.

assets.rendered_slot: Existing 20x20 icon in same36x36 toolbar button; close and check are Figma text glyphs, no added bitmap or substituted SVG.

rejected_candidates.issue: Second trigger click outside-dismissed then reopened on mouse-up. Rejected; final uses observed-state guard on mouse-down and keyboard/touch-only click activation.

Buttons internally replace their FocusHandle, leaving externally tracked row handles unmounted. Escape/keyboard routing failed. Replaced option buttons with native ListState; native Popup anchors only without wrapping toolbar keys in Popover Confirm.

focus_design: Native ListState real FocusHandle. Enter/Escape/arrows use existing list handlers, Space is scoped to list only. Closing restores the actual opening focus; keyboard invocation returns to the language button, pointer invocation preserves the previous editor/page focus. Native Popup adds no Enter/Space context to the other toolbar buttons.
